violations.description: SubmitResult dataclass defined but never instantiated — submit() returns raw dicts. Dead code violates YAGNI and creates a maintenance burden where dict keys must be manually kept in sync with dataclass fields. Since the dataclass is never used as a return type, it should either be removed or used as the actual return type.

invalidate() marks binding as invalidated but never removes it from _bindings dict. The ticket states 'removes binding and its event.' Invalidated bindings accumulate in memory for the orchestrator's lifetime, creating a memory leak risk in long-running orchestrator processes. Should either delete the binding or document the leak as accepted.

review_notes: All 66 tests pass (contract unit tests + broker unit tests + FastMCP integration test + TDD node/graph tests with Pydantic migration). Ruff lint passes.
Pydantic migration clean: TypedDict → BaseModel with same fields. All usages updated to attribute access (model_validate, model_dump, .status).
ContractBroker implementation matches the gap analysis interface. Schema registry, binding lifecycle, validation, lock-on-success, expiry, invalidation all present.
TddNode still has its own retry loop — expected per ticket scope (retry loop removal deferred to a later issue).
FastMCP integration test on random port works end-to-end with streamable-http.
The SubmitResult dataclass dead code and invalidate() memory leak are minor but should be fixed before this code reaches production.
